title: Errors and debugging map
intro: This module teaches how JavaScript signals and handles failures. You will learn built-in Error types and custom subclasses, try/catch/finally with manual type checks, unhandled promise rejections in browser and Node.js, stack traces and source maps for production debugging, and how the model compares to C# typed exceptions and when filters.

overviewDiagram.title: Failure handling and debugging flow
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  START[Code runs] --> THROW{Failure?}
  THROW -->|sync throw| UNWIND[Stack unwinds]
  THROW -->|promise reject| PROMISE{await or .catch?}
  UNWIND --> CATCH{catch present?}
  CATCH -->|yes| HANDLE[Inspect err instanceof]
  CATCH -->|no| UNCAUGHT[uncaughtException / console]
  PROMISE -->|yes| HANDLE2[Handled in try/catch]
  PROMISE -->|no| UNH[unhandledRejection]
  HANDLE --> FINALLY[finally cleanup]
  HANDLE2 --> FINALLY
  FINALLY --> DEBUG[Stack + source maps in DevTools]

conceptCards.title: Error types and throwing
conceptCards.summary: Throw Error or subclasses for message and stack. TypeError, ReferenceError, RangeError classify failures. Error.cause wraps root cause like C# InnerException.

conceptCards.title: try, catch, finally
conceptCards.summary: Same keywords as C# but one catch only — branch with instanceof inside. finally always runs. await inside try for async errors.
conceptCards.example: catch (err) { if (err instanceof HttpError && err.status === 429) await retry(); }

conceptCards.title: Unhandled rejections
conceptCards.summary: Rejected promises without .catch or await become unhandledRejection. try { asyncFn(); } does not catch — use await.

conceptCards.title: Stack traces and debugging
conceptCards.summary: err.stack lists call frames. Source maps map bundles to TypeScript. DevTools breakpoints and debugger statement pause execution.

conceptCards.title: JavaScript vs C# exceptions
conceptCards.summary: C# enforces Exception types and when filters. JS throws any value; maps when to if in catch, using to try/finally, unobserved Task to unhandledRejection.
